plan: FICTIONAL EVALUATION FIXTURE. I hold a Ukrainian passport and live in Poland on a temporary residence card. I'm considering spending about two months this winter in Thailand or Indonesia, then returning to Poland.

assignment.objective: Entry, permitted stay, and work conditions for the planned stay.

findings.title: Permitted stay may be shorter than two months
findings.observation: Depending on the destination and the traveller's nationality, the visa-free or visa-on-arrival period may be shorter than the planned two months.
findings.why_it_matters: Staying longer than permitted could lead to fines, removal, or future entry bans.
assumptions: The traveller does not hold a visa for a longer stay

findings.title: Remote work during a visitor stay may be restricted
findings.observation: If the traveller works remotely while abroad, visitor or tourist status may not permit it, depending on the destination's rules.
findings.why_it_matters: Working without the right status could breach immigration conditions.
assumptions: The traveller intends to work during the stay

assignment.objective: Returning to the country of residence after the stay.

findings.title: Return depends on residence card validity
findings.observation: If the residence card expires or loses validity during the trip, returning to the country of residence could be harder.
findings.why_it_matters: The traveller could be refused re-entry or need a visa to return.
assumptions: The residence card's validity covers the return date
